findings.detail: Step solves R y = -b in descending i with ascending j; variance solves R^T y = gradient in ascending i/j then sums y_i squared. Packed index and floating operation order are unchanged.

Step checks each stored y immediately and aborts at first nonfinite value. Variance completes all substitutions and square accumulations before its existing final nonfinite-total rejection. Output writes, acquire/release and caller pointer checks remain outside helper and unchanged. No new scratch or persistent state.

Static 24680 to 24672 B. Existing baseline and new candidate target probes both return 0 with 664 B observed stack; combined 25344 to 25336 B is an 8 B improvement. Do not reject for stack growth on this witness.

Reviewed and independently reran check.py: 1000 paired solves, 20 matched failures, max residual 7.390171765402668e-16. Additional independent probe covered every diagonal position with zero, NaN, +/-Inf and finite 1e-310 (division overflow): 160 paired solves, 96 matched failures. Outputs remained sentinel on all failures; scratch and output arrays matched with NaN-aware equality.

limitations: Observed stack is not worst-case stack.
M23 instructions executed on M33 QEMU are not target timing.
Direct equality is NaN-aware numeric equality, not a universal NaN payload or signed-zero bit-identity claim. No long-stream control run for this extraction.
Inherited disjoint external-array and serialized-owner contract applies.
Eight byte gain does not establish complete firmware fit, lifetime rounding or calibrated coverage.
